conditionalElements.description: RolePage derives mode from searchParams.switch; 'switch'=user actively switching role from sidebar (shows X, router.back() on click), 'welcome'=first-time onboarding-guard redirect (no X, no way back). Bare visit to /candidate/role with no query param -> mode='welcome' -> no close button. CDP-verified both branches: welcome mode (S0) has no Close button/heading 'Welcome to Mira'/subtitle 'Choose your role'; navigating to ?switch=1 (S1) shows Close button + heading 'Switch role' + subtitle 'Choose the role to switch to'. Clicking Close correctly called router.back() and returned to /candidate/role (S0).

summary.keyBehavior: No login wall (session was already authenticated). Bare visit to /candidate/role with no query params lands directly on the role-selection screen in 'welcome' mode: heading 'Welcome to Mira', subtitle 'Choose your role', three role cards (Agency/Consultant, Job Seeker, Employer). No close (X) button is rendered in this mode, matching source (X only appears when mode='switch', i.e. ?switch=1). Navigating to /candidate/role?switch=1 (S1) confirms the alternate entry point: heading becomes 'Switch role', subtitle 'Choose the role to switch to', and a Close (X) button appears in the header; clicking Close correctly triggers router.back() and returns to S0 (/candidate/role, no query param) -- functions as designed. The Employer card is correctly and permanently disabled (opacity-50, no hover affordance, no mobile overlay button, native disabled attribute on its CTA) in both modes -- clicking it via CDP timed out as non-interactive and the URL never changed, confirming intended behavior, not a bug. Agency and Job Seeker cards are both fully interactive (mobile overlay button + desktop CTA button both present, disabled=false) but were NOT clicked through to completion because both trigger a real DB write (setCandidateRole) plus a hard full-page navigation, per the crawl brief's instruction not to complete the full onboarding flow.
